subject: general
question: Which of following is used to treat bacterial infection inside the human body?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Antibiotic.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Antibiotics** are used to treat or stop some kinds of bacterial infections.** They work by killing bacteria or stopping them from reproducing and lay out.**
 
• Antibiotics either **kill bacteria or end them multiplying. **
 
• Antibiotics aids the body's immune system to** fight bacteria.**
 
• Bacterial infections are frequently treated with **topical antibiotics put in directly to the skin or with oral antibiotics.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​ **Anaesthetic, **also spelt anaesthetic, is **any representative that produces a local or common loss of sensation, counting pain**.
 
• An antiseptic is **a material that stops or hang up the growth of microorganisms**.
 
• Antipyretic is **a negotiator that reduces fever**.
